purpose: estimate useful worker capacity and reinforcement need from observed crew evidence rather than raw headcount

crew_depth_dimensions.role_depth: competence in assigned role from observed accepted work and receipts
crew_depth_dimensions.repo_familiarity: knowledge of target repository/subrepo structure and history
crew_depth_dimensions.mission_familiarity: knowledge of mission doctrine, gates, authority and current first-red
crew_depth_dimensions.runtime_proof_depth: ability to execute and interpret bounded/exact-SHA runtime
crew_depth_dimensions.rex_depth: ability to consume, generate and reuse relevant REX
crew_depth_dimensions.cross_mission_depth: ability to transfer useful findings across mission boundaries
crew_depth_dimensions.tool_readiness: availability and demonstrated use of required tools/resources

normalization: each dimension is 0..1 when measured; expert-seeded values must be marked SEEDED and excluded from measured PCA until observed

effective_worker_capacity.formula: EWC = availability * CD * task_role_match * evidence_confidence * (1 - coordination_drag)
effective_worker_capacity.range: 0..1 equivalent effective worker for one bounded task
notes: coordination_drag rises with unnecessary parallelism, handoffs and unresolved dependency coupling
specialists may have high EWC for one task and low EWC for another

crew_team_capacity.coupling_factor: 0..1 observed or provisionally estimated from dependency/communication graph
crew_team_capacity.anti_double_count: two crew members sharing the same bottleneck or authority gate do not count as fully additive capacity

mission_pressure.formula: MP = weighted normalized sum of observed pressure dimensions
mission_pressure.requirement: weights and values must be provenance-bound; seeded pressure is planning-only

decision.persistent_high: architectural bottleneck review before adding more workers

reinforcement_selection.objective: maximize marginal pressure reduction per crew-time
reinforcement_selection.candidate_score: MPR = task_role_match * expected_pressure_reduction * evidence_confidence * reuse_multiplier / (crew_time_cost * coordination_penalty)
avoid: adding runners before runnable path exists
adding builders before authority/gate is clear

rex_effect.capacity_credit: reused REX may lower mission pressure or increase EWC, but only after observed benefit
rex_effect.reinforcement_learning_loop: mission return -> REX update -> crew-depth update -> pressure recompute -> reinforcement recompute

role_specific_examples.GEOGRAPHER: reinforce when breadth denominator or unexplored surfaces dominate pressure
role_specific_examples.GEOLOGIST: reinforce when hidden/nested strata or unresolved subprojects dominate pressure
role_specific_examples.NEURON: reinforce when dependency graph, cycles, orphan/floating nodes or critical-path uncertainty dominate pressure
role_specific_examples.CALLIGRAPHER: reinforce when workflow/state ambiguity causes handoff or execution errors; not as a substitute for missing evidence
role_specific_examples.RUNNER: reinforce when runnable paths exist and queue/execute pressure dominates
role_specific_examples.QA_SIGNALMAN: reinforce when verification/provenance backlog limits promotion
role_specific_examples.REX_KEB: reinforce when repeated defects or semantic conflicts recur across missions
